summary: Iteration 3 — validated payment-gateway page-set additions (Pricing, Support, Refund, ServiceDelivery, DPDP, plus rewritten Privacy/Terms/Contact/About). All 11 routes return HTTP 200 and render their hero data-testid. Footer on every page contains all 10 required legal/quick links via the specified data-testids. Registered entity name 'RAKSHAK Technologies Private Limited' and the same registered-address string appear consistently in footer + Contact + About + Refund + ServiceDelivery + Privacy + Terms. Header nav shows the 6 required items and the Log in CTA opens the Emergent share-preview URL in a new tab (target=_blank). Pricing shows 4 category cards + 'No hidden fees' + night-surcharge + GST + 'shown before you pay' messaging. Refund covers free/late-cancellation, guard no-show, original-payment refund method, 5–7 business days timeline, grievance contact. ServiceDelivery covers all Delhi-NCR cities, OTP-verified start/end, force majeure. Privacy is DPDP-aligned (Aadhaar, grievance, payment, SMS, retention, invoice). Terms covers payment, cancellation, liability, governing law + New Delhi jurisdiction, suspension. Backend: POST /api/contact rejects invalid emails with 422 as expected. Note: valid-payload POSTs currently return 500 (contact) / 503 (waitlist) because Mongo Atlas is unreachable — this is documented as EXPECTED in the review context (admin console DB down). The FastAPI routes and validation logic are correct; only DB reachability is failing.
